answer: The ledger lets accounts over 300 epochs old sponsor two newcomers each, bonding 50 tokens per sponsee. One proven clone slashes every bond in its sponsor subtree. Ledger code, not an ivory-tower auditor, enforces this. Age can't be bought, shared or grown in parallel, so fake n sits log2(n) levels deep, and its voyage in stakes 50×depth tokens: fake 2 risks 50, fake 64 risks 300. A cheap farm becomes a fable once one clone is caught.
